item.title: Atomic Token-Bucket API Rate Limiting in SQLite WAL Without Redis Lua Scripts

item.title: Enforcing Deterministic Token Ceilings and Multi-Provider Failover in Tool-Calling Loops

item.title: Why Naive Exponential Backoff Causes Retry Storms (And Fixing HTTP 429 With Full Jitter in Pure Python)

item.title: Constant-Time HMAC Webhook Verification & Integer-Cent Double-Entry SQL Ledgers in Python
item.description: How to verify raw webhook bytes in constant time, block intra-window replay attacks with SQLite WAL nonces, and record zero-drift integer-cent journal postings.

item.title: Replacing Redis Queue With a 180-Line Transactional SQLite WAL Job Broker & Dead-Letter CLI
item.description: Benchmarking atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE visibility leases, duplicate webhook suppression, and poison-pill dead-letter isolation on a single SQLite WAL file.

item.title: Zero-Dependency Python Circuit Breakers & Self-Repairing JSON Routers for Unreliable LLM APIs
